name: Nerosuferoth
notes: Common in Junon Area / Fort Condor & Battle Square. Susceptible to all magic and physical attacks.

name: Ultimate Weapon

steals.note: Accessory with large stat boosts that inflicts Death Sentence at the start of battle.

notes: Flees after a few turns and must be chased across the world map, ramming it with the Highwind to start each fight. Ultima Beam hits the whole party. Its final act is Shadow Flare on whoever lands the killing blow; give that character Enemy Skill to learn it.

steals.note: Accessory with large stat boosts that inflicts Death Sentence at the start of battle.

name: Guard Scorpion
notes: Search Scope only marks the next target and does no damage. When it raises its tail, stop attacking: any hit while the tail is up triggers Tail Laser on the whole party. Defend or heal until the tail lowers, then go back to Bolt and attacks.

ai_summary.title: Each turn (8-turn cycle)
rows: Search Scope marks a random member (“Locked On Target”); it does no damage.
Attacks the marked member: Scorpion Tail 1 in 3, and always below half HP; otherwise Rifle.
Raises its tail, raising its Defense and Magic Defense. The first time, Barret says to attack while the tail is up: don't.
Lowers its tail; the cycle starts over.

ai_summary.title: Counter
rows: Any action against it: Tail Laser on the whole party.

name: Air Buster
notes: Hits to its back deal far more damage, and each one draws a counter: usually it turns and uses Bodyblow on the attacker, otherwise it fires Rear Gun. On its own turns it faces the member it targets, so alternate attackers to keep reaching its back. Fires Big Bomber at one member up to 4 times, then switches to Energy Ball and Rear Gun. Below 20% HP it can no longer turn.

ai_summary.title: Each turn
rows: Big Bomber on a random member, turning to face them first when needed (“Program 1 Operation”). After the 4th: “Big Bomber's out of ammo.”
On a random member: Energy Ball at one in front of it, Rear Gun at one behind it (“Program 2 Operation”).

ai_summary.title: Counter
rows: Counters the attacker: 2 in 3 it turns around and uses Bodyblow, otherwise Rear Gun. Hits from the front draw no counter.
“Turn Function non-operational”: it can no longer turn, so counters are always Rear Gun, and a Big Bomber turn aimed at a member behind it is lost.

ai_summary.title: Each turn
rows: An ally KO'd or below half HP, or Scotch hit
Machine Gun on a random member.

ai_summary.title: Each turn
rows: Picks one member at the start and keeps attacking them (a random member once they are KO'd). The last member to hit Scotch becomes its new target.
Scotch hit, or a Lackey KO'd

name: Aps
notes: Opens with Sewer Tsunami on the party. Any spell makes it use Sewer Tsunami twice over its next turns, and so does dropping below 1/3 HP (once). Otherwise it uses Tail Attack or Lick, which inflicts Sadness and slows Limit gauges. Cross-slash can paralyze it, and a paralyzed Aps cannot counter.

ai_summary.title: Each turn
rows: Sewer Tsunami on everyone in the battle, itself included.
1 in 4: Lick (Sadness) on the second party member (a random one if they are KO'd). Otherwise Tail Attack on a random member, preferring the back row.
Its next 4 turns: nothing, Sewer Tsunami, nothing, Sewer Tsunami; then back to normal.

name: Turks:reno
notes: Pyramid traps an ally, who then counts as KO'd; if everyone is trapped the battle is lost. Free them by attacking the Pyramid with another character. Lightning hits draw an Electro-mag Rod counter, which can paralyze. When fought with other Turks, the battle ends as soon as one Turk falls.

ai_summary.title: First fight (Lv 17)
rows: Pyramid on a random member who is not KO'd or trapped (“Try and break it if you can.”). The trapped member counts as KO'd until another member destroys the Pyramid; if everyone is trapped, the battle is lost.
Pyramid again every 3 turns, plus 1 turn for each member KO'd or trapped.
Electro-mag Rod (1 in 3, can paralyze) or Short Staff on a random member.
After a Bolt spell hits him
His next turn: Electro-mag Rod on the caster.
Frees everyone in a Pyramid and retreats (“It's time.”).

ai_summary.title: With Rude (Lv 22)
rows: Short Staff or Turk Light (half each) on a random member.
After a Bolt spell hits him
His next turn: Electroprod on the caster.
Retreats (“We may be retreating, but… we're still victorious.”).

ai_summary.title: Lv 42 fight
rows: Short Staff or Neo Turk Light (Confusion), half each, on a random member.
After a Bolt spell hits him
His next turn: Electroprod 2 on the caster.

ai_summary.title: With Rude and Elena (Lv 50)
rows: Short Staff; then Electroprod or Short Staff; then Turk Light; repeats. Always on a random member.
All three Turks retreat (“Let's call it a day.”) and the battle ends.

ai_summary.title: Pyramid
rows: Nothing: it only holds the trapped member.

steals.note: High-value Cloud weapon (+32 Atk, 4 Materia slots).

name: Sample:h0512
notes: Revives its Opt minions with Reanimagic, so ignore them and focus on H0512; they vanish when it dies. Shady Breath poisons the party and Keyclaw targets poisoned members, so cure Poison and heal everyone at once with All plus Restore.

ai_summary.title: Each turn
rows: Shady Breath (Poison) on the whole party.
Reanimagic revives the KO'd Opts while it has the MP (40 per cast).
Keyclaw on a random poisoned member; 1 in 4 Shady Breath again while someone is not poisoned.

ai_summary.title: Each turn
rows: On a random member: Bodyblow 1 in 4; Rolling Attack 1 in 4 (not while H0512 is paralyzed); Fire 1 in 12; Ice 1 in 12. Otherwise nothing.

name: Hundred Gunner
notes: Only Barret's attacks, Limits and magic reach it; use Bolt. Below two thirds HP it switches to Main Artillery on the whole party, and below one third it charges for two turns before Wave Artillery, its strongest attack. Heli Gunner follows straight after, so heal before finishing it.

ai_summary.title: Each turn
rows: Aux Artillery on a random member; after the first turn, Hidden Artillery 1 in 4.
Main Artillery on the whole party.
Charges for two turns (“Sensor Cannon Charging!”, “Sensor Cannon Charged!”), then Wave Artillery on the whole party; repeats.

ai_summary.title: Position
rows: It stands far away: only long-range attacks, magic and Limits hit it.

ai_summary.title: Each turn
rows: AB Cannon (Sleep) on a random member right away.
AB Cannon (Sleep) and C Cannon (Poison) in turn on random members; 1 in 4 turns Firing Line (Sleep, Poison) on the whole party instead.
Starts spinning: Defense and Magic Defense +50, and from then on Spinning Bodyblow or Flying Drill (half each) on a random member.

name: Rufus
notes: Cloud fights alone. Defeat Dark Nation first: it casts Barrier and MBarrier, cutting your damage. Keep Cloud healed with Cure or Potions.

ai_summary.title: Each turn
rows: Above 200 HP, when the last hit took less than 100 HP, 1 in 3 turns: laughs (“Heh, Heh, Heh…”) instead of attacking.
Retreats (“Heh… That's all for today…”), taking Dark Nation with him.

name: Dark Nation
notes: Casts Barrier and MBarrier to cut your damage. Defeat it first; magic ignores its back-row position.

ai_summary.title: Each turn
rows: Barrier on Rufus (Bite instead when out of MP).
Barrier, then MBarrier on itself, 1 in 2 turns each until both are up; other turns Bite or Bolt on Cloud.

name: Motor Ball
notes: Repeats a fixed cycle: two turns of Arm Attack on the highest-HP member (sometimes twice in one turn), then Twin Burner, Deadly Wheel and Rolling Fire on the whole party. The first time it falls below 1/8 HP it skips ahead to Twin Burner. Use Bolt, link Elemental with Fire in armor, and keep party-wide healing ready.

ai_summary.title: Each turn (7-turn cycle)
rows: Arm Attack on the member with the most HP, half the time twice.
Twin Burner on the whole party (Deadly Wheel when out of MP).
Deadly Wheel on the whole party.
Rolling Fire on the whole party (Deadly Wheel when out of MP); the cycle starts over.

name: Bottomswell
notes: Flies, so only ranged attackers (Barret, Yuffie, Long Range materia) or magic reach it. Waterball traps a member in a bubble that hurts every turn; break it with magic, since the bubble is immune to physical attacks. Below 50% HP it adds Big Wave on the party, and it uses Big Wave once more as it dies.

ai_summary.title: Forms
rows: Turns 1-3: Tail Attack on a random member. Turn 4: 1 in 3 a Tail Attack on each member, otherwise Bodyblow on the member with the most HP. Repeats.
Fury Blast, then: Moonstrike on each member; Bodyblow on the member with the most HP; Moonstrike on a random member; then more Moonstrikes, or back to normal while above 3/4 HP.
After 6 more hits, or below 1/2 HP

Waterball traps a random free member in a Waterpolo bubble, which is immune to physical attacks: break it with magic. Two turns later Big Wave on the whole party (back to normal instead while above half HP). Another Waterball follows unless someone is trapped while another member is KO'd.

ai_summary.title: Other
rows: It flies out of reach: only long-range attacks, magic and Limits hit it.
Big Wave on the whole party, and every trapped member is freed.

ai_summary.title: Bubble
rows: Immune to physical attacks; it has no turns.

name: Jenovabirth
notes: Casts Stop on one member, then uses Gas on whoever is stopped. Tail Laser hits the whole party and often comes twice in one turn, so keep everyone's HP up with Restore.

ai_summary.title: Each turn (7-turn cycle)
rows: Half the time it opens at turn 4.
Gas on a member under Stop if there is one, otherwise Stop on a member who isn't stopped.
1 in 3: Laser on each member who isn't KO'd or stopped. Otherwise three, two or one Lasers (1 in 3 each) on members who aren't stopped.
Tail Laser on the whole party, half the time twice.
Gas on a stopped member if there is one, otherwise 1 in 3 Gas on a random member. The cycle starts over.

steals.note: Deals 1500 fixed damage to all enemies.

name: Dyne
notes: Barret fights alone. Dyne uses Needle Gun, adds S-Mine below 75% HP and Molotov Cocktail below 25%, and may throw one last Molotov as he falls. Let him fill Barret's Limit gauge, heal with items when low, and finish with Limits.

ai_summary.title: Each turn
rows: Needle Gun and S-Mine every turn.
Needle Gun and Molotov Cocktail every turn.
Half the time a last Molotov Cocktail.

name: Turks:rude
notes: Will not attack Tifa unless everyone else is down. Heals allies with Cure2, can cast MBarrier, and Grand Spark hits one member hard. With the Attack Squad, clear the soldiers so melee can reach him. When fought with other Turks, the battle ends as soon as one Turk falls.

ai_summary.title: With Reno (Lv 23)
rows: 1 in 3: Fire on a random member (unless it picks Tifa). Otherwise Shoulder Attack on a random member other than Tifa.
Shoulder Attack on her 2 in 3; otherwise he only stares (“………………”).
Every second turn: Cure on Reno.

ai_summary.title: Lv 49 fight
rows: 2 in 5: Ice2, Bolt2 or Fire2 (unless it picks Tifa). Otherwise Shoulder Attack on a random member other than Tifa; with only Tifa left, he mostly stares.
Every second turn: Cure2 on his side.
His script never clears its “already acted” flag: once he has cast a spell or Cure2, he does nothing on later turns.

ai_summary.title: With the Attack Squad (Lv 42)
rows: 1 in 4: MBarrier on himself if he has none. 1 in 3: Grand Spark up to three times on random members other than Tifa. Otherwise Shoulder Attack on a random member other than Tifa.
Cure2 on himself, and Bolt2 on the last member who hit him, on top of his other action.
Retreats, and the Attack Squad leaves with him.

ai_summary.title: With Reno and Elena (Lv 51)
rows: Shoulder Attack, Shoulder Attack, Grand Spark, Shoulder Attack three times, Grand Spark; repeats. Never on Tifa while someone else stands.
Mostly stares; 1 in 3 Shoulder Attack on her.
All three Turks retreat (“Reno! Elena! Let's pull out!”) and the battle ends.

name: Soul Fire
notes: Possesses a party member and casts Fire2 on them, leaving after three turns or when the host dies. All Soul Fires die as soon as Gi Nattak is defeated, so you can ignore them.

ai_summary.title: Each turn
rows: Fire2 on itself: it absorbs Fire.
Fire2 on its host for 4 turns, then returns; it returns at once if the host is KO'd.

name: Gi Nattak
notes: Undead: Cure, Potions and other healing damage it. Two Soul Fires possess party members and cast Fire2 on their host for three turns. Defeating Gi Nattak first destroys any remaining Soul Fires, so focus him and avoid Fire.

ai_summary.title: Each turn (4-turn cycle)
rows: A Soul Fire possesses a random member (Take Over), if that Soul Fire is alive and free; otherwise Spear Attack.
On a random member: DeBarrier 1 in 3 if they have Barrier or MBarrier; otherwise Drain 3 in 5, Aspil and then Spear Attack 1 in 5, Spear Attack 1 in 5.
Both Soul Fires vanish with him.

name: Lost Number
notes: Starts half physical, half magic. Below half HP it becomes the form that matches the hit that got it there: magic leaves the red magic form, which resists magic and casts spells, and physical leaves the purple physical form, which resists physical attacks and hits one member for 2000 or more with Lost Blow. Finish the first half with magic, then use physical attacks and Limits.

ai_summary.title: First form
rows: Punch on a random member, or 1 in 3 Bolt2 on one without Reflect; the chance of a second action the same turn rises as its HP drops.
The hit that brings it there decides its new form: a physical hit leaves the purple physical form, a spell the red magic form.

ai_summary.title: Magic form (red)
rows: On members without Reflect: Bio2 (preferring unpoisoned members), Bolt2 or Quake2, 2 in 7 each; Tentacle 1 in 7. Out of MP: Aspil on the member with the most MP.

ai_summary.title: Physical form (purple)
rows: Lost Blow 1 in 4 on a random member; otherwise Punch, half the time twice.

name: Materia Keeper
notes: Trine hits the whole party (learn it with Enemy Skill), Hell Combo hits one member hard, and it heals itself with Cure2. Its special attacks come more often as its HP drops, so set Big Guard and keep All plus Restore ready.

ai_summary.title: Each turn
rows: 1 in 5 its first action is Trine.
Keyclaw or Big Horn on a random member; Hell Combo instead 1 in 5, rising as its HP drops (1 in 4 below 3/4, 1 in 3 below 1/2, 1 in 2 below 1/4).
Every fourth turn Cure2 on itself, and Trine on the whole party on the turn after (Hell Combo when out of MP).
Trine follows only a Cure2: bring it below 3/4 HP and wait.

name: Palmer
notes: Mostly harmless. Mako Gun casts Fire2, Ice2 or Bolt2 on a random member, and he can inflict Sadness. Attack with your strongest moves to finish quickly.

ai_summary.title: Each turn
rows: 1 in 4 each: “Mako Gun” Fire2, Ice2 or Bolt2 on a random member, or Incite (“Heh-hic-heh-hic!”) on a member without Sadness.
Does nothing when the chosen spell needs more MP than he has, or everyone already has Sadness.

name: Rapps
notes: Cloud's party fights without Materia, since Yuffie took it and Corneo has kidnapped her. Aero3 can deal over 1300 damage to one member, so keep everyone's HP high; Barret's Mindblow drains his MP to stop it. Scorpion's Tail can poison and is often used twice in one turn.

ai_summary.title: Each turn (4-turn cycle)
rows: Starts at a random point of the cycle.
Wing Cut on a random member.
Scorpion's Tail (Poison) on a random member.
Aero3 on a random member while he has 50 MP; nothing otherwise.
Wing Cut and Scorpion's Tail come twice in one turn 1 in 9, rising as his HP drops (1 in 7 below 3/4, 1 in 5 below 1/2, 1 in 3 below 1/4).

name: Gorkii
notes: Yuffie fights alone. His spells hit hard early but he runs out of power, so set Big Guard and outlast him.

ai_summary.title: Each turn (3-turn cycle)
rows: Barrier, Regen or Reflect on himself: the first of them he lacks. With all three up, Demi2 instead.

name: Shake
notes: Yuffie fights alone. Mostly uses Beak. Below half HP he counters with Rage Bomber, which inflicts Fury (faster Limit gauge, but she misses more); he also uses it while poisoned, so don't poison him.

ai_summary.title: Each turn
rows: Beak or Rage Bomber (Fury), half each.

ai_summary.title: Counter
rows: Every action against him: Rage Bomber (Fury) on the attacker.

name: Chekhov
notes: Yuffie fights alone. Opens with Stare Down, which paralyzes, and counters any magic with it again, so equip a Jem Ring. Below half HP he drains her with Absorb.

ai_summary.title: Each turn
rows: Absorb, on a paralyzed member if there is one.

ai_summary.title: Counter
rows: Stare Down (Paralysis) on the caster: a Jem Ring prevents it.

name: Staniv
notes: Yuffie fights alone. Alternates Ironball with War Cry (Sadness) and may counter with Iron Attack when nearly dead. Counter Attack materia speeds the fight up.

ai_summary.title: Each turn
rows: Ironball on a paralyzed member, else one with Sadness, else the member with the most HP.
If no one has Sadness, 1 in 3 a War Cry (Sadness) turn follows; then the cycle restarts.

ai_summary.title: Counter
rows: Half the time Iron Attack on the whole party.

name: Godo
notes: Yuffie fights alone. Uses gravity attacks that take a share of her HP, Trine, and Mini (Remedy or Cornucopia cures it). Late in the fight he heals with Cure2, but poison damage does not trigger it, so Bio works well. Learn Trine with Enemy Skill.

ai_summary.title: Each turn
rows: Starts at a random point of his move chain.

Beast Sword on the whole party; Sleepel (Sleep) or Mini on the whole party; Drain on the member with the most HP; Bio2, Trine or Demi3 on the whole party. He picks the next move at random, changing form first when needed: human for Sleepel and Mini, beast for Beast Sword and Trine, the third form for Drain, Bio2 and Demi3.
Beast Sword when the chosen spell isn't possible: not enough MP, Reflect, or everyone already asleep or small.
Follows Bio2 or Trine 1 in 5, rising as his HP drops (1 in 4 below 4/5, 1 in 3 below 3/5, 1 in 2 below 2/5).

ai_summary.title: Counter
rows: After every action against him, while he has MP and no Reflect: returns to human form and casts Cure2 on himself; 1 in 2 on the attacker instead when they are below 1/5 HP. Poison damage is not an action, so it never triggers this.

name: Demons Gate
notes: Hits very hard: Cave-in and Demon Rush hit the whole party, and Petrif-Eye inflicts gradual Petrify. Its special attacks come more often as its HP drops. Use Big Guard and Regen, keep Soft or Ribbons ready, and let the damage build Limit Breaks.

ai_summary.title: Each turn
rows: Falling Rocks on a random member (a second one 1 in 8), then Cave-in on the party, then Petrif-Eye (gradual Petrify, 1 in 8) or Falling Rocks; repeats from a random step. It ignores members who are petrified or petrifying.
The second Falling Rocks and Petrif-Eye come more often: 1 in 4 below 3/4 HP, 1 in 3 below 1/2, 1 in 2 below 1/4.
Each first time: Advance on its next turn, then Demon Rush on the whole party one or two turns later, and it moves back.

name: Red Dragon
notes: Usually opens with Red Dragon Breath; it and Dragon Fang each hit one member hard. Set Big Guard, heal often, and use Ice or physical attacks.

ai_summary.title: Each turn
rows: Red Dragon Breath 3 in 4, Dragon Fang 1 in 4, on a random member.
Dragon Fang 1 in 2, Red Dragon Breath 1 in 4, Tail Attack 1 in 4, on a random member.

name: Jenovalife
notes: Counters magic by casting Reflect on itself while it has MP, so lean on physical attacks and Limit Breaks. Aqualung hits the whole party; bring Enemy Skill to learn it. Its extra and special attacks get more frequent at 75%, 50% and 25% HP.

ai_summary.title: Each turn
rows: Starts at a random point of the cycle.
Blue Light on a random member, a second one 1 in 5 (rising as its HP drops: 1 in 4 below 3/4, 1 in 3 below 1/2, 1 in 2 below 1/4).
Blue Flame on a random member. With the same rising chance, Aqualung on the whole party follows; otherwise the cycle restarts.
It comes more often as its HP drops.

ai_summary.title: Counter
rows: Reflect on itself while it has none and has the MP.

steals.note: Deals 1500 fixed damage to all enemies.

name: Schizo(right)
notes: Two heads act separately and absorb different elements, so all-target Fire or Ice heals one of them. Every few hits each head counters with Tremor on the party. Each head breathes on the whole party as it dies, so heal before finishing either head.

name: Schizo(left)
notes: Two heads act separately and absorb different elements, so all-target Fire or Ice heals one of them. Every few hits each head counters with Tremor on the party. Each head breathes on the whole party as it dies, so heal before finishing either head.

name: Jenovadeath
notes: Silences one member early, so bring Echo Screens or a Ribbon. Tropic Wind hits the whole party, and its Red Light comes more often as its HP drops.

name: Carry Armor
notes: Lapis Laser hits the whole party hard and comes more often as its HP drops. Each arm can grab a member, who is out of action until that arm is destroyed or Carry Armor dies. Use all-target Bolt magic, Big Guard and Regen.

name: Turks:elena
notes: Fought with Reno and Rude; the battle ends as soon as any one Turk falls. Each Turk resists or absorbs different elements, so check each card before using all-target elemental magic. Non-elemental attacks such as Ultima or Bahamut are safest.

ai_summary.title: With Reno and Rude
rows: Throw on the whole party (“Try this on for size!”).
Kick or Throw (half each) on a random member.

“Yeow! That hurts!”: she falls back. Then: a pause, Bewildered (Confusion) on a random member, four turns of Throw on the whole party, and a last Throw on the whole party as she returns (“Take THAT!!”).
Returns at once with Throw on the whole party.
All three Turks retreat (“Let's call it a day.”) and the battle ends.

name: Proud Clod
notes: While Jamar Armor stands, Proud Clod can use Materia Jammer to put Reflect on one member, and a Ribbon does not stop it, so destroy Jamar Armor first. Proud Clod fires machine guns and beams, and once damaged enough adds Beam Cannon on the whole party. Big Guard and Regen keep the fight safe.

name: Jamar Armor
notes: Proud Clod's support unit; it has no attacks of its own. While it stands, Proud Clod can use Materia Jammer to put Reflect on a member, so defeat it first, then focus Proud Clod.

name: Hojo
notes: Summons Poodler Sample and Bad Rap Sample and brings them back when they fall, so ignore them and attack Hojo directly; defeating him ends this stage.

name: Helletic Hojo
notes: Its right arm hits hard and revives almost immediately, so focus the main body. The fight inflicts Confusion, Sleep and Silence; Ribbons make it much easier.

name: Lifeform-hojo N
notes: Relies on status attacks rather than damage. With Ribbons equipped it is barely a threat, so hit it with your strongest attacks.

name: Jenovasynthesis
notes: Below 15,000 HP it starts a countdown and then casts Ultima, which ends the fight with no EXP or AP, so defeat it before the count runs out. Repeating Slap can inflict Fury and Absorb Sadness; it also casts Bio2 (Poison) and Stop.

name: Bizarrosephiroth
notes: Its Core restores a large share of the main body's HP almost every turn, so put your heaviest damage on the main body, or defeat the Core if the healing outpaces you.

name: Safersephiroth
notes: Equip Ribbons: Pale Horse, Break and his wing attack inflict statuses, and DeSpell strips your buffs. Super Nova hits the whole party. Use Big Guard, Regen, and your strongest summons and Limits; Shadow Flare can be learned here.

name: Sephiroth
notes: Final one-on-one with Cloud, who starts with a full Limit gauge. Any attack wins.

name: Diamond Weapon
notes: Immune to physical attacks at first. When it starts counting down to Diamond Flash it opens up to physical hits, so switch to attacks and Limits then. Diamond Flash hits the whole party and can Silence, so set Big Guard and heal before the count runs out.

name: Ruby Weapon
notes: Cannot be damaged until it plants its tentacles in the sand. Whirlsand removes a member from the battle for good but cannot target the last active character, so start with two members KO'd and revive them once the tentacles are down. Not immune to Paralysis: Dazers stop its attacks.

name: Ruby's Tentacle
notes: Ruby Weapon cannot be damaged until these are planted in the sand. Focus the main body rather than the tentacles.

name: Emerald Weapon
notes: Without Underwater materia the fight has a 20-minute timer. Aire Tam Storm deals 1111 damage per equipped materia to each character, so keep everyone at 8 or fewer. Emerald Beam hits the whole party and removes Regen.

name: Eye
notes: Emerald Weapon's eyes: blue eyes fire damaging lasers and orange eyes drain MP. The fight is won by defeating Emerald Weapon itself.
